title: ID0375930-DC/Si-D/TR-[Multi-27 devices] DCx Errorcode:7
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
After the v5.0.19 firmware update, we have encountered "Errorcode:7" on several devices. This issue puts the outlets into an "out of service" state. Today alone, we saw this error on 27 devices. We rebooted all of them; some were fixed, but others were not. The list of devices that experienced the "Errorcode:7" issue today is below. We request that even if a reboot temporarily resolves the issue, this ticket should remain open until the problem is fully resolved.
In addition to the "Errorcode:7" issue, some devices appear to be charging even though there is no active charging process.
Root cause: FW Bug
Solution: FW update
On DAMEX Sanctioned List:  Siemens Employee
Warranty Status:
2024-25-08 : Notes from L2 to L3
Notes from ES to NOC [ 30/08/2024]

additional_info.body:
Dear Emre,
I hope all is well with you. I'm Sambath, and I'll be supporting you on this case from expert team. As the charger is working fine now and the issue is already addressed by FW v 5.0.21, which is going to be released by CW 38, I am proceeding to close the ticket. Please be aware that this issue can be temporarily resolved by rebooting the charger.
In case this error becomes severe and affects the charger operation, please plan to downgrade the charger by either Cfast card flashing or request remote support to roll back the previous FW.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Sambath.K.S
